title: Doug_Craftco_Sales_Kit (1)
universal_lens: Sales process as iterative state transition system with feedback loops; target acquisition, engagement, and follow-up mapped to Markovian decision processes. Structural unification of sales engagement as a stochastic process with local contact optimization and resource availability.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian belief updating over prospect states using likelihood functions derived from 4-question inquiry protocol; conformal predictive intervals for next-step probabilities. Bayesian inference models customer intent through sequential engagement signals; GSI maps contact probability to conversion likelihood using prior distributions over project cycles.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning engine models prospect engagement as dynamic state-space traversal; transitions governed by action-value functions optimized via reinforcement learning. Situational reasoning encodes local supplier proximity and operational capacity into state transitions; GSE evaluates readiness for quote generation via facility constraints and lead-time estimation.

primitives.name: Target Acquisition Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: THE MACHINE (memorize this) Target → Call / Visit → Ask for the next step → Write it down → Follow up.
primitives.assumptions: Prospects are discrete entities with deterministic response behavior under defined stimuli.
primitives.breakdown_regime: T → C → S forms a Markov chain with absorbing state S.

layer2.mapping: State transition function T(t+1) = f(T(t), C(t)) where C(t) is stochastic variable drawn from contact distribution.
layer2.telemetry: Number of new contacts per day and conversion rate to next-step commitments.

primitives.name: Engagement Protocol Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: EVERY WEEK — the numbers • 25 new contacts • 8 meetings (minimum) THE 4 QUESTIONS (ask every prospect) 1.
primitives.assumptions: Each question elicits a binary response indicating readiness to proceed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Q ∈ {1,2,3,4} defines conditional probability space P(Q|D) = 1 iff D is provided.

layer2.mapping: Kernel function K(Q,P) = ∑_{q=1}^{4} δ(q - Q) * P(D_q) where δ is Kronecker delta.
layer2.telemetry: Average time between question delivery and receipt of drawing/specs request.

primitives.name: Follow-Up Mechanism
primitives.verbatim_quote: Follow up with every warm account that owes you a next step.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F': 'follow-up frequency (per week)', 'W': 'warm account pool size (dimensionless)', 'N': 'next-step owed (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Warm accounts form a subset W ⊆ T with N < W and F > 0.
primitives.breakdown_regime: F = N/W implies exponential decay of outstanding steps over time.

layer2.mapping: Exponential decay model: N(t) = N₀ e^{-kt} where k = F/W.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of warm accounts followed up within 48 hours of next-step declaration.

primitives.name: Weekly Volume Target
primitives.verbatim_quote: DOUG'S CRAFTCO SALES KIT Craftco — Houston / Texas Territory.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'V_w': 'weekly volume target (contacts/week)', 'M_w': 'minimum meetings per week (dimensionless)', 'C_d': 'daily contact goal (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Daily contact goal C_d = V_w / 5 ensures uniform distribution across weekdays.
primitives.breakdown_regime: V_w = 25 implies C_d = 5; M_w = 8 sets minimum meeting threshold.

layer2.telemetry: Deviation from weekly contact and meeting targets measured as percentage variance.

primitives.name: Cranage Capacity Scaling
primitives.verbatim_quote: Two 10-ton cranes, 30-ft doors on three sides, water jet that cuts up to 12" thick.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Crane_{total}': 'Total lifting capacity of dual crane system (units: metric tons)', '10\\,\\text{tons}': 'Capacity of a single overhead crane unit (units: metric tons)'}
primitives.assumptions: Constant load distribution across dual cranes, standard hook factor of 0.85 applied.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs at 22.5-ton combined payload due to structural deflection limits.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI multi-dimensional conformal prediction intervals for equipment throughput.
layer2.telemetry: Average hourly lift cycles per crane as verification metric

primitives.name: Material Hardness Scaling
primitives.verbatim_quote: Steel, stainless, titanium, and the hard alloys — Inconel, Hastelloy, Duplex.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Hardness_{max}': 'Maximum hardness achievable by superalloys (units: Rockwell C-scale)', 'Inconel\\,_718': 'Nickel-chromium superalloy composition', '38\\,\\text{HRC}': 'Rockwell hardness threshold for wrought Inconel 718'}
primitives.assumptions: Room temperature testing, solution heat-treated condition assumed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Brittle fracture initiates at stress concentrations above 35 HRC under dynamic loading.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE state-transition models for material fatigue under cyclic stress.
layer2.telemetry: Fatigue life cycles to failure at 38 HRC as empirical observable

primitives.name: Overflow Quoting Probability
primitives.verbatim_quote: Can we quote your next one?" Equipment & Crane Makers Machined parts, weldments, overflow when slammed.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P(Overflow)': 'Probability of shop being overloaded (dimensionless)', 'N_{slammed}': 'Count of instances where shop capacity exceeded demand', 'N_{total}': 'Total number of production cycles observed'}
primitives.assumptions: Stationary Poisson arrival process for orders, exponential service time distribution.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Queue length diverges when arrival rate exceeds service rate, leading to infinite wait times.

layer2.mapping: Derived from GSI queueing network inference for supplier capacity utilization.
layer2.telemetry: Average queue waiting time as verification metric

primitives.name: Drawing Requirement Threshold
primitives.verbatim_quote: What do you reorder?" EVERY TIME: leave with drawings or a sample part.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A_{drawing}': 'Area of geometric features requiring detailed documentation (units: square inches)', 'A_{critical}': 'Threshold area below which simplified quoting suffices (units: square inches)', 'P(Quote)': 'Conditional probability of receiving a formal quote given drawing availability'}
primitives.assumptions: Geometric complexity directly correlates with required documentation volume.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Discontinuity at zero information content; no drawing implies uniform prior uncertainty.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE feature extraction algorithms for CAD model simplification ratios.
layer2.telemetry: Average file size reduction ratio after documentation compression

primitives.name: Local Supplier Contact Optimization
primitives.verbatim_quote: Hi [Name], I'm Doug Baxley with Craftco — custom metal fabrication, CNC machining, and welding.
primitives.assumptions: Supplier location L is fixed; contact C is a function of local presence R.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When L > threshold, C approaches unity; when R < threshold, C degrades.

layer2.mapping: Contact optimization maps to Bayesian belief update over supplier reliability; GSI infers intent from communication frequency.
layer2.telemetry: Email open rate, follow-up response time

primitives.name: Facility Resource Capacity Mapping
primitives.verbatim_quote: I live and work in Houston, so you'd have a local contact, backed by a 25,000 sq ft shop with water jet, laser, and 10-ton cranes for larger jobs.
primitives.assumptions: A is static; T and M define operational envelope.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When A < required area, T drops; when M < job load, T fails.

layer2.mapping: Resource capacity defines feasible production space; GSE evaluates feasibility via constraint satisfaction.
layer2.telemetry: Quote turnaround time, job size compliance

primitives.name: Engagement Intent Signal
primitives.verbatim_quote: I'm not asking you to switch anything — just to be on your list for the next planned project or overflow job.
primitives.assumptions: I is a monotonic function of P and O.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P increases, I decays; when O rises, I increases.

layer2.mapping: Intent signal aligns with GSI's probabilistic model of project alignment; GSE tracks intent via behavioral indicators.
layer2.telemetry: List inclusion rate, project mention frequency

primitives.name: Communication Effort Minimization
primitives.verbatim_quote: Could I send a one-page capability sheet and get 15 minutes?
primitives.assumptions: E is inversely proportional to D and directly to T.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When D > 1, E increases exponentially; when T < 10, E is minimized.

layer2.mapping: Minimizing effort reflects GSE's cost-benefit optimization; GSI models communication efficiency.
layer2.telemetry: Email response delay, meeting scheduling speed

primitives.name: Supplier Role Categorical Mapping
primitives.verbatim_quote: Houston (look up) Equip/Crane Shop Mgr COLD Osborn Technical Services Houston (look up) Equip/Crane Production Mgr COLD CraneWorks Houston Houston (look up) Equip/Crane Custom Fab Mgr COLD Cisco-Eagle Houston (look up) Equip/Crane Project Eng.
primitives.assumptions: Roles are discrete categories with defined functional domains in crane manufacturing and service.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When role ambiguity exceeds 0.3 threshold in supplier matrix.

layer2.mapping: Each role maps to a node in a directed acyclic graph representing workflow dependencies in crane production.
layer2.telemetry: Role assignment accuracy in procurement decision trees.

primitives.name: Material Composition Specification
primitives.verbatim_quote: Metals Carbon/alloy steel, stainless, Duplex, Inconel, Hastelloy, titanium, aluminum, wear plate, + plastics.
primitives.assumptions: Material types form a finite set with distinct mechanical properties.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When material property mismatch exceeds 15% variance in specification compliance.

layer2.mapping: Material type vector space enables kernel-based similarity metrics for component compatibility.
layer2.telemetry: Compliance rate of material specifications against ISO 9001 standards.

primitives.name: Manufacturing Capability Dimensionality
primitives.verbatim_quote: Cutting/forming 5-axis water jet cuts up to 12" thick (cold, no distortion).
primitives.assumptions: Machine capabilities define bounded parameter spaces for part fabrication.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When part dimensions exceed machine capability by more than 10%.

layer2.mapping: Capability vectors map to geometric constraint manifolds in CAD/CAM systems.
layer2.telemetry: Utilization efficiency of lathe and bore capacity in production scheduling.

primitives.name: Cutting Precision Envelope
primitives.verbatim_quote: Contact 680 Airfield Lane, Sheridan WY 82801 • 307-672-9220 • Sales: Samuel George, sgeorge@craftco.com Lift & size Two 10-ton + one 5-ton overhead cranes.
primitives.assumptions: Precision envelope defines maximum allowable deviation in cutting operations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When thickness exceeds 12" or distortion exceeds 0.001 inches.

layer2.mapping: Precision envelope forms kernel function for assessing cut quality in material processing.
layer2.telemetry: Deviation from nominal cut profile in post-processing inspection.
